scenario:
An academic research-focused institution is developing an advanced platform for managing and analyzing research publications, their authors, and citation metrics. The platform will support researchers by providing detailed insights into publication trends, author collaborations, and citation impacts. It will include features such as tracking publications across various platforms, managing author profiles, and analyzing citation networks and trends over time.

The system should allow for complex querying capabilities to identify the most cited works, understand the collaboration networks of researchers, and examine the evolution of research topics over time. Furthermore, the platform should support multiple citation styles and facilitate integration with external research databases for enriching metadata about publications.

Additionally, the platform should cater to administrative needs by providing tools for managing author affiliations, tracking publication counts for performance evaluations, and generating detailed reports on research output and impact. User roles will range from researchers who access and download citation data to administrators who manage author profiles and institutional affiliations.
